description: Change a Dynamics 365 opportunity and/or close it. fields: logical names (read first, If-Match on the etag). outcome "won" or "lost" closes it through WinOpportunity/LoseOpportunity with close_subject, actual_revenue, close_date (YYYY-MM-DD), close_note and for lost lost_reason "canceled" (default) or "outsold"; status_code only for custom status reasons. Only open opportunities can be closed. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity to change

outcome.description: Close the opportunity as won or lost

status_code.description: Custom status reason code for closing

name: update_dynamics_opportunity
